title: Sell Mineral Rights in Minor, AL
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Minor, AL | Cash Offer
metaDescription: Minor, Jefferson County mineral or royalty owner? We buy Black Warrior Basin coalbed methane interests with a fair, no-pressure cash offer.
heroLead: Minor sits west of Birmingham in a stretch of Jefferson County that has stayed relatively rural, and mineral titles here often reflect that, larger original tracts, fewer subsequent subdivisions, and comparatively simple family ownership.
intro: For an owner whose family has held Minor-area land for generations without much turnover, the mineral title work can be some of the more straightforward research we do in this county. That does not mean the value is automatically higher, but it usually means fewer surprises during the process.

sections.heading: Rural land, simpler chains of title
paragraphs: A tract that has passed directly from parent to child a couple of times, without ever being carved up and sold to outside buyers, is much easier to trace than land that changed hands repeatedly through the twentieth century. Minor has more of the former than many parts of Jefferson County, which speeds up the confirmation process on our end.
If your family's Minor land fits this pattern, bring us your deed and any recent statement and we can usually move to a quote quickly.

sections.heading: Considering a partial sale
paragraphs: Some Minor families are not looking to sell everything, just a portion of the interest, keeping a share to pass down while converting the rest into cash now. We can structure a purchase around a specific percentage of your interest if that fits your goals better than an all-or-nothing sale.
This kind of partial sale is worth discussing if you want liquidity now but also want future generations to retain some connection to the family's mineral estate.

faqs.question: Can I sell just half my interest and keep the rest?
faqs.answer: Yes, partial sales are common and we can structure an offer around whatever percentage you want to sell.

faqs.question: Is Minor land typically less subdivided than other Jefferson County areas?
faqs.answer: Generally yes, which tends to make title research faster since there are fewer past transactions to trace.

faqs.question: What if my family has never leased this land at all?
faqs.answer: We can still evaluate it based on proximity to active units and geologic position, and explain honestly what that means for value.

faqs.question: Do you buy interests where the surface is still farmed or timbered?
faqs.answer: Yes, an active surface use does not affect our ability to purchase the separate mineral interest underneath it.

faqs.question: How do partial sales get valued compared to a full sale?
faqs.answer: We simply apply the same per-unit valuation to whatever percentage you choose to sell, so a half-interest sale is priced consistently with a full one.
